pageValues.value: Victoria Hutter thanked Adam for his quick response and made additional comments regarding NEA direct grants to small and medium-sized organizations. She offered to provide additional information if needed.
The NEA has been open about its funding of the Public Theater and provided information to reporters, sharing that no NEA funding went to the particular production of 'Julius Caesar'.
The NEA declined to comment on whether the Public had applied for any grants for this summer season. The Public Theater received $25,000 this year for the New York Voices program at Joe's Pub.
